summary: Patient forgot the outpatient appointment because she did not receive a reminder message and requested to rebook for next week.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for next week and verify the patient's contact information for future reminders.

summary: Patient missed the appointment because they live far away and could not find transportation.
recommended_action: Contact patient to discuss telehealth options or assistance with transportation.

summary: Patient skipped the appointment because the consultation fee was too high and inquired about discounts.
recommended_action: Provide information on available financial assistance or discount options for follow-up visits.

summary: Patient missed the outpatient appointment due to high fever and body ache, and will reschedule after recovery.
recommended_action: Contact the patient once they have recovered to reschedule the outpatient appointment.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to an urgent office meeting and requested an evening slot for future visits.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for an evening time slot.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment because they did not receive an SMS reminder and wants to reschedule.
recommended_action: Help the patient rebook the outpatient appointment and ensure reminder preferences are active.

summary: Patient could not be reached after three attempts because their phone was switched off.
recommended_action: Attempt to contact the patient again later or send a written outreach message.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a factory shift change and inability to take leave.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment for a Saturday as requested by the patient.
